an5.141:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.141:1.3: Datvā avajānāti, saṃvāsena avajānāti, ādiyamukho hoti, lolo hoti, mando momūho hoti.
an5.141:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo datvā avajānāti? 3.
an5.141:2.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo datvā avajānāti.
an5.141:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo saṃvāsena avajānāti? 4.
an5.141:3.2: Idha bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasati dve vā tīṇi vā vassāni.
an5.141:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo saṃvāsena avajānāti.
an5.141:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ādiyamukho hoti? 5.
an5.141:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo parassa vaṇṇe vā avaṇṇe vā bhāsiyamāne taṃ khippaṃ yeva adhimuccitā hoti.
an5.141:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ādiyamukho hoti.
an5.141:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo lolo hoti? 6.
an5.141:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhattī ittarapemo ittarappasādo.
an5.141:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo lolo hoti.
an5.141:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo mando momūho hoti? 7.
an5.141:6.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kusalākusale dhamme na jānāti, sāvajjānavajje dhamme na jānāti, hīnappaṇīte dhamme na jānāti, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme na jānāti.
an5.141:6.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo mando momūho hoti.
an5.141:6.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
